question: Should ClawHub core accept runtime-managed promotions now as a permanent public/admin/feed surface, including the production snapshot-publish deploy step?
rationale: The code appears coherent, but the PR creates durable platform state and a public contract whose acceptance depends on maintainer product and release intent rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Verify And Merge
options.body: Approve core promotions, prove the snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Direction Lands
options.body: Leave the PR draft until promotion ownership, release timing, and the OpenClaw consumer path are confirmed.

options.title: Redesign Outside Core
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if promotions should live as external campaign metadata or provider/plugin-owned integration instead of ClawHub core state.

recommendation.title: Verify And Merge
recommendation.body: Approve core promotions, prove the snapshot publish command on a safe deployment path, then undraft and merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current feature branch and have adjacent main-history context, though final product approval still needs maintainer authority.
